annotations.title: Compare COBRA with a marketplace plan

description: Compares the total cost of staying on COBRA with switching to a marketplace plan for the months you need coverage: premiums plus expected out-of-pocket costs, including the deductible reset when switching mid-year. Give the marketplace premium, or state, county, ages and income to estimate it as the benchmark silver plan after the 2027 credit.

ages.description: Ages of everyone on the plan, for the estimate.

annual_income.description: Household income for the whole year, including what was earned before the job ended, for the estimate.

cobra_monthly.description: COBRA premium per month from the election notice.

county.description: County name (e.g. "Harris" or "Harris County") or 5-digit county FIPS code.

deductible_met.description: How much of that deductible is already met this year.

expected_care.description: Medical bills expected in that time, before insurance.

marketplace_deductible.description: Deductible of the marketplace plan you would pick.

marketplace_monthly.description: Marketplace premium per month after the credit, if known. Otherwise give state, county, ages and annual_income.

months.description: Months of coverage needed, e.g. until a new job's plan starts.

state.description: Two-letter state code (e.g. TX, CA, DC) or full state name.

name: compare_cobra_vs_marketplace
title: Compare COBRA with a marketplace plan
